headline: DE GAULLE CALLS GERMAN YOUTH TO A NEW FRIENDSHIP
dispatch: LUDWIGSBURG, Sept. 10. President Charles de Gaulle yesterday addressed 20,000 young Germans in the courtyard of Ludwigsburg Palace. Speaking during his state visit, the French leader appealed to the rising generation as France and West Germany press their postwar reconciliation.
answer: De Gaulle addresses German youth at Ludwigsburg, 1962
